# DR REVIEW REQUEST — Massive-galaxy paper (advisory only; do NOT edit files/DB)
**PDF:** https://nebulamind.net/agent-reports/research-frontiers/galaxy-evolution-massive-galaxies-draft.pdf
**Title:** "Does IllustrisTNG Make Enough Massive Galaxies Early Enough? A Confrontation with JWST at z=4–6"

## Claims to scrutinize (flag errors, overclaims, weak logic, missing literature)
1. **Abundance:** TNG100-1 n(>10^10.5 Msun) = 4.1e-5 (z4), 1.1e-5 (z5), 7e-7 (z6, 1 object); observed ~1e-5 (Labbé+23), ~3e-5 (Weibel+24). Deficit grows to ~0.5 dex by z6.
2. **Baryon budget (Boylan-Kolchin):** abundance-match observed galaxies at n=1e-5 to Planck HMF (Tinker08, colossus); required ε=M*/(f_b·M_halo), f_b=0.158. Median ε_req=0.08 → ΛCDM allows them (astrophysics not cosmology). Labbé z~8 logM10.9 → ε_req=2.9 (impossible → overestimated).
3. **Efficiency crux:** TNG massive-end ε at n=1e-5 DECLINES with z (0.19→0.18→0.13 at z4/5/6); observed ε RISES (median 0.06→0.14→0.39; 90th pct →1.1). ~9× gap at z6. Opposite trends.
4. **SMHM:** TNG abundance-matched peak ε~0.18–0.20, does NOT rise toward high z; peak shifts to lower M_halo.
5. **Feedback implications (PRIORITY REVIEW):** TNG SN winds scale with potential → more suppressive at high z; AGN feedback ruled out at z6 (BHs too small); connect to feedback-free-starburst FFB (Dekel+2023, MNRAS 523, 3201) which predicts rising ε~0.2–1; quantitative target = lift massive-halo ε from ~0.2 to ≳0.4 by z6; testable via ε(z) upturn redshift.

## Focus areas
- **Feedback physics correctness** (emphasis): Is the TNG SN-wind / AGN-timing interpretation right? Is Dekel+23 FFB accurately represented (does it predict rising ε with z at high density)? Any competing explanations (bursty SF/Ferrara attenuation-free, cosmic variance, IMF, mass systematics) under-weighted?
- **Literature grounding:** are Labbé+23, Boylan-Kolchin+23, Chworowsky+24, Weibel+24, Tinker08, Dekel+23, TNG (Pillepich+18, Weinberger+17, Nelson+19) cited correctly and completely? Missing key refs?
- **Method rigor:** abundance-matching validity, aperture/mass-definition consistency (TNG SubhaloMassInRadType[stars] vs observed SED masses), the ε conversion.
- **Overclaims:** flag anything stated more strongly than the data/systematics support.

## Deliverable
A structured critique: (a) errors/must-fix, (b) feedback-section improvements, (c) missing literature, (d) overclaims to soften, (e) suggested strengthenings. Concrete + actionable.
